**Configuration:**
- The session cookie name is `session_token`.
- Tag names are validated against the canonical pattern `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9])?$` (1–40 chars, lowercase alphanumerics and internal hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen, must include at least one alphanumeric).
- A video's resolved tag set may contain between 0 and 20 unique entries; resolved sets above 20 are rejected with `too_many_video_tags`.
- The `GET /api/videos` query parameter `tags` is a comma-separated list of tag UUIDs interpreted with OR semantics among the listed tags; unknown ids are ignored.
- The `GET /api/videos` query parameter `folderId` accepts a single UUID or the literal `unfiled` and is combined with the `tags` selection using AND semantics.
- The web app proxies `/api/tags`, `/api/tags/{id}`, and `/api/videos/{id}/tags` to the backend while preserving request cookies and response bodies.
- The web app extends the existing `/api/videos` proxy with `tags` and `folderId` query parameters in addition to the F04 `sort` parameter.
- F06 provides a test-only environment value `LIBRARY_FILTER_FOLDER_OVERRIDE` (semicolon-separated `videoId=folderId` mappings) that lets the contract drive the `folderId` AND filter without F05 being implemented; when set, the `folderId` query parameter on `GET /api/videos` is interpreted against this synthetic mapping. For the F06 contract run, `LIBRARY_FILTER_FOLDER_OVERRIDE` maps `tag-video-folder-bucket` to the synthetic folder id `synthetic-folder-courses` and leaves every other `tag-user` video unmapped.
- Backend tag and library-filter configuration values are read through `apps/backend/src/config/env.ts`.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| User can create tags with lowercase 1–40 character names (hyphens allowed, no spaces) | API-CREATE-01, API-CREATE-02, API-CREATE-03, UI-EDIT-TAGS-02, E2E-CREATE-AND-FILTER-01 |
| A video accepts between 0 and 20 tags | API-APPLY-05, API-APPLY-06, UI-EDIT-TAGS-03 |
| Tags are shared across the library and reused across videos | API-APPLY-01, API-APPLY-02, API-LIST-02 |
| Library can be filtered by one or more tags using OR semantics between tags and AND with an active folder filter | API-FILTER-01, API-FILTER-02, API-FILTER-03, API-FILTER-04, UI-LIBRARY-PILLS-02 |
| Renaming a tag updates every video that uses it | API-RENAME-01, API-RENAME-03, UI-MANAGE-RENAME-01, E2E-RENAME-PROPAGATION-01 |
| Deleting a tag removes it from every video; videos are not deleted | API-DELETE-01, UI-MANAGE-DELETE-01, E2E-DELETE-PROPAGATION-01 |
| "Manage tags" view lists every tag with its usage count | API-LIST-01, UI-MANAGE-LIST-01 |
| Video records provided by upload (F03) can be associated with tags (F06) and filtered in a tag-filtered view | API-APPLY-01, API-FILTER-01, E2E-CREATE-AND-FILTER-01 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Create

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-CREATE-01` — valid name creates a tag for the actor
- given: (default), and no tag named "courses" exists for `tag-user`
- when: POST `/api/tags` with body `{ "name": "courses" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 201
  - body tag has shape `{ id, name: "courses", usageCount: 0 }`
  - the persisted tag belongs to `tag-user`
  - the persisted tag name is "courses"

#### `API-CREATE-02` — uppercase or space input is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST `/api/tags` with body `{ "name": "Mixed Case Tag" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_tag_name`
  - body message identifies "Mixed Case Tag" as the offending value
  - body message names the lowercase + hyphens-only canonical pattern
  - no `tags` row is created for `tag-user` with that name

#### `API-CREATE-03` — leading or trailing hyphen is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST `/api/tags` with body `{ "name": "-edge" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_tag_name`
  - body message identifies "-edge" as the offending value
  - no `tags` row is created for `tag-user` with that name

#### `API-CREATE-04` — duplicate name for the same user is rejected
- given: (default), and a tag named "courses" already exists for `tag-user`
- when: POST `/api/tags` with body `{ "name": "courses" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 409
  - body code is `tag_already_exists`
  - body message identifies "courses" as the offending value
  - the existing tag's id is unchanged

### List

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and the seeded tags and videos exist.

#### `API-LIST-01` — list returns every actor-owned tag with usage count
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/tags` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tags include `tag-lecture`, `tag-rnn`, `tag-attention`, `tag-draft`, and `tag-extra` and only those (plus any tag created earlier in the same run)
  - the entry for `tag-lecture` has usageCount equal to the count of `tag-user` videos associated with `tag-lecture` (`tag-video-lecture-rnn`, `tag-video-lecture-only`, `tag-video-folder-bucket`, `tag-video-many-tags`)
  - the entry for `tag-rnn` has usageCount equal to the count of `tag-user` videos associated with `tag-rnn` (`tag-video-lecture-rnn`, `tag-video-many-tags`)
  - the entry for `tag-extra` has usageCount 1 (only `tag-video-many-tags` is associated with `tag-extra`)
  - the entries are ordered alphabetically by name
  - no entry belongs to `other-tag-user`

#### `API-LIST-02` — same tag is reusable across multiple videos
- given: (default), and `tag-lecture` is associated with both `tag-video-lecture-rnn` and `tag-video-lecture-only`
- when: GET `/api/tags` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - the body entry for `tag-lecture` has a single canonical `id`
  - that entry's usageCount counts each consuming video exactly once

### Apply

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-APPLY-01` — replaces a video's tag set with existing tag ids
- given: (default), and `tag-video-untagged` has zero tags, and `tag-lecture` and `tag-rnn` exist for `tag-user`
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with body `{ "tagIds": ["{tag-lecture.id}", "{tag-rnn.id}"], "newTagNames": [] }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tags lists `{ id: tag-lecture.id, name: "lecture" }` and `{ id: tag-rnn.id, name: "rnn" }` (order-independent)
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` are exactly `(tag-lecture.id, tag-rnn.id)`

#### `API-APPLY-02` — inline-creates a new tag and attaches it
- given: (default), and `tag-video-untagged` has zero tags, and no tag named "fresh" exists for `tag-user`
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with body `{ "tagIds": ["{tag-lecture.id}"], "newTagNames": ["fresh"] }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tags includes `{ id, name: "fresh" }` with a freshly minted id
  - body tags includes `{ id: tag-lecture.id, name: "lecture" }`
  - a new `tags` row exists for `tag-user` with name "fresh"
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` are exactly `(tag-lecture.id, fresh.id)`

#### `API-APPLY-03` — empty desired set clears all tags from the video
- given: (default), and `tag-video-untagged` has been pre-populated with `tag-lecture`
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with body `{ "tagIds": [], "newTagNames": [] }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tags is an empty array
  - no `video_tags` row exists for `tag-video-untagged`
  - the `tags` row for `tag-lecture` is unchanged

#### `API-APPLY-04` — applying another user's tag id returns not found
- given: (default), and the supplied tag id is `other-tag-user-tag.id` (owned by `other-tag-user`)
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with body `{ "tagIds": ["{other-tag-user-tag.id}"], "newTagNames": [] }` and `tag-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `tag_not_found`
  - body message identifies the offending tag id
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` are unchanged

#### `API-APPLY-05` — resolved set above twenty is rejected
- given: (default), and the request resolves to 21 unique tag ids after dedup
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with that 21-entry payload and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 422
  - body code is `too_many_video_tags`
  - body message identifies the resolved count "21" and names the 20-tag cap
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` are unchanged

#### `API-APPLY-06` — resolved set of exactly twenty is accepted
- given: (default), and the request resolves to 20 unique tag ids after dedup
- when: PUT `/api/videos/{tag-video-untagged.id}/tags` with that 20-entry payload and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tags has 20 entries
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` count 20

### Filter

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and the seeded tag-video associations exist.

#### `API-FILTER-01` — filter by a single tag returns only matching videos
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos?tags={tag-lecture.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `tag-video-lecture-rnn` and `tag-video-lecture-only`
  - body videos do not include `tag-video-untagged`

#### `API-FILTER-02` — filter by multiple tags applies OR semantics
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos?tags={tag-rnn.id},{tag-attention.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `tag-video-lecture-rnn` (has `tag-rnn`)
  - body videos include `tag-video-attention-only` (has `tag-attention`)
  - body videos include each video at most once
  - body videos do not include `tag-video-lecture-only` (has neither `tag-rnn` nor `tag-attention`)

#### `API-FILTER-03` — filter by tag plus folder applies AND with the folder
- given: (default), and the F06 test override `LIBRARY_FILTER_FOLDER_OVERRIDE` maps `tag-video-folder-bucket` to `synthetic-folder-courses`
- when: GET `/api/videos?tags={tag-lecture.id}&folderId=synthetic-folder-courses` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `tag-video-folder-bucket`
  - body videos do not include `tag-video-lecture-rnn` (matches the tag but not the folder)
  - body videos do not include `tag-video-lecture-only` (matches the tag but not the folder)

#### `API-FILTER-04` — folder filter with no matching tag yields empty
- given: (default), and the F06 test override `LIBRARY_FILTER_FOLDER_OVERRIDE` maps only `tag-video-folder-bucket` to `synthetic-folder-courses`
- when: GET `/api/videos?tags={tag-rnn.id}&folderId=synthetic-folder-courses` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos is empty (no `tag-user` video has both `tag-rnn` and the synthetic folder)

### Rename

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-RENAME-01` — valid rename updates the tag
- given: (default), and `tag-lecture` has name "lecture"
- when: PATCH `/api/tags/{tag-lecture.id}` with body `{ "name": "lectures" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body tag is `{ id: tag-lecture.id, name: "lectures" }`
  - the persisted tag name is "lectures"

#### `API-RENAME-02` — collision with another tag name is rejected
- given: (default), and `tag-lecture` and `tag-draft` both exist for `tag-user`
- when: PATCH `/api/tags/{tag-draft.id}` with body `{ "name": "lecture" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 409
  - body code is `tag_already_exists`
  - body message identifies "lecture" as the offending value
  - the persisted name for `tag-draft` is unchanged
  - the persisted name for `tag-lecture` is unchanged

#### `API-RENAME-03` — every consuming video reflects the new name
- given: (default), and `tag-lecture` is associated with both `tag-video-lecture-rnn` and `tag-video-lecture-only`
- when: PATCH `/api/tags/{tag-lecture.id}` with body `{ "name": "lectures" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - the body tag name is "lectures"
  - GET `/api/videos?tags={tag-lecture.id}` returns the same set of videos (`tag-video-lecture-rnn`, `tag-video-lecture-only`) under the new tag name
  - the canonical tag id remains stable across the rename

#### `API-RENAME-04` — renaming another user's tag returns not found
- given: (default), and the target tag is `other-tag-user-tag` (owned by `other-tag-user`)
- when: PATCH `/api/tags/{other-tag-user-tag.id}` with body `{ "name": "stolen" }` and `tag-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `tag_not_found`
  - the persisted name for `other-tag-user-tag` is unchanged

### Delete

**Common given:** `tag-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-DELETE-01` — delete removes the tag and detaches it from every video
- given: (default), and `tag-lecture` is associated with `tag-video-lecture-only` (and other `tag-user` videos)
- when: DELETE `/api/tags/{tag-lecture.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 204
  - no `tags` row exists for `tag-lecture.id`
  - no `video_tags` row exists referencing `tag-lecture.id`
  - the `videos` row for `tag-video-lecture-only` still exists

#### `API-DELETE-02` — second delete returns not found
- given: `tag-draft` has already been deleted by an earlier call
- when: DELETE `/api/tags/{tag-draft.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `tag_not_found`

#### `API-DELETE-03` — deleting another user's tag returns not found
- given: (default), and the target tag is `other-tag-user-tag`
- when: DELETE `/api/tags/{other-tag-user-tag.id}` with `tag-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `tag_not_found`
  - the persisted `other-tag-user-tag` row is unchanged

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, gestures); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Library Pills

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `tag-user` and the seeded tags and tag-video associations exist.

#### `UI-LIBRARY-PILLS-01` — filter pill row exposes every actor tag
- given: (default)
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the page shows a tag filter pill row that includes pills labeled "lecture", "rnn", and "attention"
  - the pills are ordered alphabetically by name
  - no pill belongs to `other-tag-user`

#### `UI-LIBRARY-PILLS-02` — toggling pills filters the visible cards with OR semantics
- given: (default), and the library is rendered with no pill selected
- when: click the pill for `tag-lecture` and then the pill for `tag-rnn`
- then:
  - both pills indicate a selected state
  - the visible cards include `tag-video-lecture-rnn` (matches `tag-rnn`)
  - the visible cards include `tag-video-lecture-only` (matches `tag-lecture`)
  - cards with no `tag-lecture` and no `tag-rnn` association are not visible

### Card Pills

#### `UI-CARD-PILLS-01` — card renders up to three tag pills inline and collapses extras into +N
- given: the browser is authenticated as `tag-user`, `/app` is open, and `tag-video-many-tags` is visible with five tag associations
- when: locate the `tag-video-many-tags` card on the page
- then:
  - the card shows exactly three tag pills inline
  - the card shows a `+2` indicator next to the inline pills
  - the inline pills correspond to actual tag names of `tag-video-many-tags` (any three of its five associations)

### Edit Tags

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `tag-user`, `/app` is open, and the edit-tags dialog for `tag-video-untagged` is open.

#### `UI-EDIT-TAGS-01` — selecting an existing tag attaches it to the video
- given: (default)
- when: type "lecture" in the tag combobox, choose the existing `tag-lecture` suggestion, and submit the dialog
- then:
  - the dialog closes
  - the `tag-video-untagged` card shows a tag pill labeled "lecture"
  - the persisted `video_tags` rows for `tag-video-untagged` include `tag-lecture.id`

#### `UI-EDIT-TAGS-02` — invalid name shown inline by the combobox
- given: (default)
- when: type "Mixed Case" in the tag combobox
- then:
  - the combobox does not offer a "Create tag 'Mixed Case'" option
  - an inline message identifies that names must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only
